scope: Paused development candidate; dynamic delegation and CPU fixes are not GPU performance results.
decode_batch_semantics: Native decodes its admitted running batch, capped at 8; no separate decode slice is tuned.
headroom_policy: Borrow capacity until needed; price restore plus input/decode reserves; prepare and reclaim only safe waiting states. Never preempt an active LLM.

comparison_policy.attribution: Main comparison measures the complete system; isolate KV policy benefits with the matched-frontend ablation.
comparison_policy.incomplete_work: Retain through common cutoff in restricted JCT.

acceptance_observations: Observed model-selected rounds, fanouts, depths, and independent JOINs, rather than prescribed shape.
Physical demand H2D and pre-completion restored and reused FULL, separated by EOS, JOIN and submission boundaries.
Native-valid idle capacity, copies newly prepared, actual capacity reclaimed and service reserves.
Useful Host-only copy loss and same-session recomputation; more concurrency can increase both.
